question: Should the staged-proof architecture and Administration-scoped ruleset-verifier rollout land together on this exact head?
rationale: Source review supports the implementation, but accepting a new GitHub App permission and deploying a redesigned privileged finalizer is an operational security-boundary choice that automation cannot make.

options.title: Approve integrated rollout
options.body: Confirm the App permission and land the complete receipt-bound pipeline after exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Stage privileged rollout
options.body: Keep automated merging disabled until the verifier permission and live artifact-transfer path are separately proven.

options.title: Split the rollout
options.body: Separate staged proof from privileged mutation if maintainers prefer smaller independently deployable changes.

recommendation.title: Approve integrated rollout
recommendation.body: Confirm the App permission and land the complete receipt-bound pipeline after exact-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the proposed design and current validation implementation, while repository-owner involvement remains necessary for the App permission change.
